seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Zephyrhills, Florida for 2026: Festival of Lights and Christmas Parade, Dade City parade and Santa breakfast, with dates checked.
lede: Zephyrhills celebrates with a downtown Festival of Lights and Christmas Parade, library crafts and a city hall breakfast with Santa, and nearby Dade City adds its own Christmas parade.
celebrates: The City of Zephyrhills holds a tree lighting ceremony each season and a Festival of Lights and Christmas Parade at Clock Plaza on 5th Avenue, with food trucks, live music, craft vendors and a parade that starts at 7 pm. The Zephyrhills Public Library runs a monthly kids' craft program, and Zephyrhills City Hall hosts a Breakfast with Santa. In nearby Dade City, the Pioneer Florida Museum's events calendar lists the Dade City Christmas Parade, always free for spectators.
lastyear: Last season, Dade City's Downtown Christmas Stroll ran Saturday, December 13, 2025, from 5 to 9 pm with horse-drawn carriage rides, live music and carolers, according to a Fun 4 Tampa Kids calendar post. A Facebook listing called it the 41st annual stroll, with more than 80 vendors, free carriage rides, free ornament decorating, a kids zone and Santa. We list only events with a 2026 host page.
facts: Dade City is the Pasco County seat and the home of the Pioneer Florida Museum. The museum's calendar lists Pioneer Days, the Hummingbird Festival and a Country Christmas among its events. The Dade City Christmas Stroll is billed as the 42nd annual on Visit Florida, and the Main Street Zephyrhills tree lighting is held each year in late November.
trains: We did not find a train ride in Zephyrhills or Dade City. The nearest rail history on this site is the Henry B. Plant Museum in Tampa. New Port Richey's Light Up the Night tree lighting on December 4 lists train rides, and our Tampa page covers more holiday options in the Tampa Bay area.
train_links: A Tampa museum in the former Tampa Bay Hotel, a short drive south of Pasco County.

Is there a free Christmas event in Zephyrhills?
The Dade City Christmas Parade is always free for spectators, according to the Pioneer Florida Museum. Public parades are listed as free to watch, and the Breakfast with Santa is listed as free.
Where can kids meet Santa in Zephyrhills?
Zephyrhills City Hall hosts Breakfast with Santa on December 19. See the listing on this page for the details.
Is there a train ride in Zephyrhills?
We did not find one. The closest rail history on this site is in Tampa, and New Port Richey has train rides at its tree lighting.
Dade City has only one verified 2026 event so far, the Christmas Parade, so it is covered on this page. Its Christmas Stroll date is still unconfirmed.

The magic runs from December 4 (the Dade City Christmas Parade) through December 19 (Breakfast with Santa at Zephyrhills City Hall), with the Zephyrhills Festival of Lights and Christmas Parade (December 5) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.
